observations: Photo 0 shows a disassembled car headlight assembly lying on a concrete floor, with visible wiring and internal components. The housing is black plastic with some white and green connectors.
Photo 1 shows a single headlight unit with a black lens, orange turn signal, and a clear LED array. The unit is placed on a concrete floor, with a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI VICTOR TOCHI'.

Photo 2 shows the rear of the headlight assembly, revealing the mounting points, wiring harness, and a silver-colored plastic cover over the bulb housing. The unit is on a concrete floor, with a watermark 'VICTOR TOCHI'.
All photos show a watermark 'VICTOR TOCHI' and a timestamp '26/08/2026 18:06', which is in the future. The photos appear to be taken in a workshop or garage setting.
No visible branding or model markings are readable on the headlight units in any photo.
The seller claims it is for a Toyota Avalon 2014-2016, but no such label or part number is visible in the photos.

The unit appears clean in photo 1, but the photos show a workshop environment with dirt and debris. The condition is not fully verifiable without a close-up of the lens and housing for scratches or wear.
